verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's orange-tinted photo, so it becomes a dark purple background. Both also leave an empty orange rectangle in the centre as a dead focal point, blow the play icon up so it rivals the 'Pygmalion' headline, and push 'Music and lyrics' out of the title group to the far right. In A the leftover frame lines form a stray bracket that hits the play icon. In B those lines are cut down to small dashes beside the text: still meaningless, but less messy.
